author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
After my little team has built our own incompatible Jira for the 3rd time, I change my opinion about Altassian's stock value.

Maybe people will stay with Jira after all, even it is easy to vibe code your own Jira.  It is hard for different engineers (even I am their boss and we are all AI-native) vibe code different versions of Jira that are compatible with each other.

On the other hand, it is pretty easy to vibe code a Jira bridge, then sync the tickets in our ad-hoc Jira back to the mothership Jira.
